source_description: GitHub issue #402 — audit_interpretation oversized commits 400 the API. Ships Option A (upfront size guard) per the issue's recommended sequence: estimate prompt size before LLM call, short-circuit to synthetic JUDGMENT_REQUIRED if over threshold. Code-change-only mission (no office2 deploy in this mission). Unblocks felix-doc-auditor.timer re-enable when combined with the post-#411 fix.
